values.label: Miscellaneous
values.note: Miscellaneous — a container, not a catch-all leaf: Superhero, Comedy, LGBTQ+ and Romance hang off it. Do not read it as 'other'.

values.label: Campaigns, Adventures & Modules
values.note: Campaigns, Adventures & Modules. A commit once claimed DriveThruRPG had no adventures category and built a cross-store hazard on it; this is that category. Closest counterpart to DMs Guild 45393-adventures, though cut differently — this one carries the level bands as children.

values.label: GM-less
values.note: GM-less, with Solo / 2+ Players / Gamebooks beneath it. DMs Guild files solo play under theme instead (45752); same concept, different axis.

values.label: Other systems
values.note: Other systems — a REAL node (id 9999, parent 30) and the parent of roughly eighty systems, not a UI control. An earlier commit recorded it as a 'disclosure control, not a value' after the Refine button revealed its children. Half right: the Refine button is a control, but 9999 is a genuine container node in the tree, exactly like More Settings on DMs Guild. Roll its children up to it; never treat a product under it as unclassified.

values.label: Old-School Revival (OSR)
values.note: Old-School Revival (OSR) — parent of the individual OSR games (Mork Borg, Shadowdark, Old-School Essentials, Cairn…). Counting 'OSR' by this id alone misses every product tagged only to a specific game.

values.label: 5e
values.note: 5e — the 2014 rules, under Official D&D. Note the id differs from DMs Guild's 45462 for the same concept: per-store ids, never joinable.

values.label: Cauldron of MIst - City of Mist
Cauldron of Mist - Legend in the Mist
5.5e
values.note: 5.5e — the 2024 rules. This repo stated four times that the 2014-vs-2024 split was not a facet and required LLM inference. It is a facet on BOTH stores.

values.label: Virtual Tabletops (VTT)
values.note: Virtual Tabletops. Children name the platforms — Foundry, Fantasy Grounds, Roll20, Demiplane — so VTT platform share is directly measurable.

values.label: Creation Method
values.note: Creation Method — the AI-disclosure axis, mirroring DMs Guild 1000140. Children declare AI vs human authorship.
